title.en: Configure Syslog in Diagnostic Settings for Azure VMware Solution

summary.en: Ensure Diagnostic Settings are configured for each private cloud to send syslogs to external sources for analysis and/or archiving. Azure VMware Solution Syslogs contain data for troubleshooting and performance, aiding quicker issue resolution and early detection of issues.

rationale.en: Diagnostic configuration creates a path from service events to retained records. Category selection, destination access and recent ingestion must all be checked; enabling a setting without delivered records leaves an observability gap.
rationale.ko: 진단 구성은 서비스 이벤트를 보존된 기록으로 전달하는 경로를 만듭니다. 범주 선택, 대상 접근과 최근 수집을 모두 확인해야 합니다. 설정만 활성화하고 기록이 전달되지 않으면 관찰 공백이 남습니다.

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.AVS/privateClouds. Specific focus: AVS syslog delivery.
Identify supported categories, destinations, retention and any regional or service-specific export restrictions.
applicability.ko: 지원되는 범주, 대상, 보존 기간과 지역 또는 서비스별 내보내기 제약을 확인합니다.

applicability.en: AVS private-cloud and cluster limits, vSAN storage policy, HCX and ExpressRoute have separate support boundaries. Validate the current vendor-supported topology.
applicability.ko: AVS 프라이빗 클라우드와 클러스터 한도, vSAN 저장소 정책, HCX와 ExpressRoute는 지원 경계가 다릅니다. 현재 공급업체가 지원하는 구조를 검증합니다.

before.en: Relevant events may be absent, sent to an inaccessible destination or retained for too short a period.
before.ko: 필요한 이벤트가 없거나 접근할 수 없는 대상으로 전송되거나 보존 기간이 너무 짧을 수 있습니다.

before.en: Recommendation-specific baseline to inspect: Diagnostic settings route AVS syslog to a destination with recent accepted events. This is an inspection question, not a finding about the current environment.

after.en: Required categories reach a controlled destination with recent records and sufficient investigation retention.
after.ko: 필수 범주를 통제된 대상으로 전달하고 조사에 충분한 기간 동안 최근 기록을 보존합니다.

after.en: Intended source-specific outcome: Configure Syslog in Diagnostic Settings for Azure VMware Solution. Validate using: Diagnostic settings route AVS syslog to a destination with recent accepted events.

implementation_steps.en: Identify the actual in-scope Microsoft.AVS/privateClouds objects and read their current AVS syslog delivery configuration. Record the scope and observation time; do not infer inventory from this conceptual guide.
Choose the exact source categories and destination, validate identity and network permissions, and define retention and access controls before enabling collection.
implementation_steps.ko: 정확한 원본 범주와 대상을 선택하고 신원 및 네트워크 권한을 검증합니다. 수집 전에 보존 기간과 접근 통제를 정합니다.

implementation_steps.en: Review the pinned APRL action 'Configure Syslog in Diagnostic Settings for Azure VMware Solution' against the original description and cited documentation. Prepare a supported, scoped change proposal and rollback; this guide itself does not execute or approve changes.
Prepare independent observations for: Diagnostic settings route AVS syslog to a destination with recent accepted events. Resolve unsupported or ambiguous conditions before proposing a change.

verification_steps.en: Inspect and retain source-attributed configuration or workload evidence for: Diagnostic settings route AVS syslog to a destination with recent accepted events.
Generate or use an authorized known event and locate its source, event time and ingestion time in the destination. Check category completeness and delivery errors.

verification_steps.en: Compare the observed AVS syslog delivery behavior with this recommendation's intended mechanism and the original source. Record timestamps, scope, missing coverage and conflicting observations.
Keep the existing automated, manual, blocked or unsupported assessment disposition separate. Missing evidence stays unknown; a diagram, a setting write or API acceptance is not operational success.

title.en: Implement retry logic in your client

summary.en: Cosmos DB SDKs automatically manage many transient errors through retries. Despite this, it's crucial for applications to implement additional retry policies targeting specific cases that the SDKs can't generically address, ensuring more robust error handling.

rationale.en: Transient failures can be retried, but persistent errors and non-idempotent operations need different handling. Bounded attempts, delay and jitter limit retry amplification and preserve an observable terminal failure.
rationale.ko: 일시적 오류는 재시도할 수 있지만 지속적인 오류와 멱등성이 없는 작업은 다르게 처리해야 합니다. 횟수, 지연과 지터를 제한해 재시도 폭증을 막고 최종 실패를 관찰할 수 있어야 합니다.

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.DocumentDB/databaseAccounts. Specific focus: Cosmos client retry.
Classify the exact SDK or job errors, timeout budget, server retry hints and duplicate-side-effect risks.
applicability.ko: 정확한 SDK 또는 작업 오류, 시간 제한, 서버의 재시도 안내와 중복 부작용 위험을 분류합니다.

applicability.en: Cosmos DB regional, write and consistency settings interact with SDK routing. Continuous backup and multi-region replication are separate protection mechanisms.
applicability.ko: Cosmos DB의 지역, 쓰기와 일관성 설정은 SDK 라우팅과 상호작용합니다. 연속 백업과 다중 지역 복제는 별도 보호 기능입니다.

before.en: Immediate failure loses recoverable work, while unbounded retries can overload a dependency or duplicate side effects.
before.ko: 즉시 실패하면 복구 가능한 작업을 잃고, 무제한 재시도는 의존 리소스를 과부하시키거나 부작용을 중복 발생시킬 수 있습니다.

before.en: Recommendation-specific baseline to inspect: SDK retry policy honors throttling delays with bounded attempts and idempotent application writes. This is an inspection question, not a finding about the current environment.

after.en: Retryable conditions use bounded delay and an overall deadline with idempotent outputs and terminal failure handling.
after.ko: 재시도 가능한 조건에 지연과 전체 기한을 제한하고 멱등한 출력과 최종 실패 처리를 마련합니다.

after.en: Intended source-specific outcome: Implement retry logic in your client. Validate using: SDK retry policy honors throttling delays with bounded attempts and idempotent application writes.

implementation_steps.en: Identify the actual in-scope Microsoft.DocumentDB/databaseAccounts objects and read their current Cosmos client retry configuration. Record the scope and observation time; do not infer inventory from this conceptual guide.
Choose supported retryable errors, honor server delay hints, set per-attempt and total deadlines and make writes or job outputs safe to repeat.
implementation_steps.ko: 지원되는 재시도 대상 오류를 선택하고 서버의 지연 안내를 따릅니다. 시도별 및 전체 기한을 정하고 쓰기나 작업 출력을 안전하게 반복할 수 있게 합니다.

cautions.en: Retries are not failover or a cure for sustained quota exhaustion; stacked SDK and application retries can multiply load.
cautions.ko: 재시도는 장애 조치나 지속적인 할당량 부족의 해결책이 아닙니다. SDK와 애플리케이션의 재시도가 겹치면 부하가 배로 늘 수 있습니다.

label.en: Designing resilient applications with Azure Cosmos DB SDKs

title.en: Replicate production databases to DR location (ASYNC) using the vendor's replication technology

summary.en: Replicate production databases (ASYNC) to the DR location using the database vendor's replication technology.

rationale.en: Replicas provide additional serving or recovery copies, but the mechanism differs between compute replicas, synchronous state replication and asynchronous data replication. The source recommendation determines which model applies; lag and shared failure domains remain important.
rationale.ko: 복제본은 추가 처리 용량이나 복구용 사본을 제공합니다. 컴퓨팅 복제본, 동기 데이터 복제, 비동기 데이터 복제는 서로 다릅니다. 원본 권고가 요구하는 방식을 확인하고 복제 지연과 공통 장애 범위를 검토합니다.

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.Subscription/subscriptions. Specific focus: SAP asynchronous DR copy.
Confirm whether the recommendation concerns serving instances, data replicas or artifact replicas and which failover or promotion operations are supported.
applicability.ko: 권고가 처리 인스턴스, 데이터 복제본, 배포 아티팩트 중 무엇을 대상으로 하는지 확인하고 지원되는 장애 조치와 승격 방식을 검토합니다.

applicability.en: Use the supported SAP, OS and database HA design. Synchronous local HA, asynchronous DR, fencing, load-balancer probes and shared files are not interchangeable.
applicability.ko: 지원되는 SAP, OS와 데이터베이스 HA 설계를 사용합니다. 동기 로컬 HA, 비동기 DR, 펜싱, 부하 분산기 프로브와 공유 파일은 서로 바꿔 쓸 수 없습니다.

applicability.en: The source classifies this specialized workload under a subscription. The actual objects to inspect are the SAP asynchronous DR copy targets and their dependencies, not a subscription setting assumed to implement the recommendation.
applicability.ko: 원본은 이 전문 워크로드를 구독 아래 분류합니다. 실제 점검 대상은 권고에 명시된 리소스와 그 의존성입니다. 구독 설정 하나가 권고를 구현한다고 가정하지 않습니다.

before.en: One serving copy or an unverified replica can leave the workload dependent on the original instance or location.
before.ko: 처리 사본이 하나뿐이거나 복제본을 확인하지 않으면 원래 인스턴스나 위치에 계속 의존할 수 있습니다.

before.en: Recommendation-specific baseline to inspect: Vendor-supported ASYNC database replication, lag and explicit data-loss acceptance at failover. This is an inspection question, not a finding about the current environment.

after.en: The required replica set is healthy, sufficiently independent and connected to an explicit serving or recovery procedure.
after.ko: 필요한 복제본의 상태와 독립성을 확인하고 명시적인 처리 또는 복구 절차에 연결합니다.

after.en: Intended source-specific outcome: Replicate production databases to DR location (ASYNC) using the vendor's replication technology. Validate using: Vendor-supported ASYNC database replication, lag and explicit data-loss acceptance at failover.

implementation_steps.en: Identify actual SAP asynchronous DR copy target objects inside the workload's subscription scope and read their specific current configuration. Subscription classification is not a substitute for identifying host pools, shares, clusters or other real targets.
Provision the source-specific replica topology, configure synchronization or workload distribution, and document who selects a replacement and how clients reconnect.
implementation_steps.ko: 권고에 맞는 복제본 구조를 준비하고 동기화 또는 부하 분산을 구성합니다. 대체 대상을 선택하는 담당자와 클라이언트 재연결 방법을 문서화합니다.

implementation_steps.en: Review the pinned APRL action 'Replicate production databases to DR location (ASYNC) using the vendor's replication technology' against the original description and cited documentation. Prepare a supported, scoped change proposal and rollback; this guide itself does not execute or approve changes.

Prepare independent observations for: Vendor-supported ASYNC database replication, lag and explicit data-loss acceptance at failover. Resolve unsupported or ambiguous conditions before proposing a change.

verification_steps.en: Inspect and retain source-attributed configuration or workload evidence for: Vendor-supported ASYNC database replication, lag and explicit data-loss acceptance at failover.
Inspect each actual replica, readiness and any lag, then validate loss of the original path using an approved exercise or prior evidence. Check data consistency as well as request availability.
verification_steps.ko: 실제 복제본의 준비 상태와 지연을 확인한 뒤 승인된 시험이나 기존 기록으로 원래 경로가 사라졌을 때의 동작을 검증합니다. 요청 가용성과 데이터 일관성을 함께 확인합니다.

verification_steps.en: Compare the observed SAP asynchronous DR copy behavior with this recommendation's intended mechanism and the original source. Record timestamps, scope, missing coverage and conflicting observations.
Keep the existing automated, manual, blocked or unsupported assessment disposition separate. Missing evidence stays unknown; a diagram, a setting write or API acceptance is not operational success.
verification_steps.ko: 기존의 자동, 수동, blocked 또는 미지원 평가 상태를 별도로 유지합니다. 정보가 없으면 알 수 없음으로 남깁니다. 그림, 설정 쓰기나 API 수락은 운영 성공이 아닙니다.

cautions.en: Replication can propagate deletion or corruption. It is not a substitute for retained recovery points, and asynchronous replication can lose recent writes at failover.
cautions.ko: 복제는 삭제나 손상도 전달할 수 있으므로 보존된 복구 지점을 대신하지 못합니다. 비동기 복제는 장애 조치 때 최근 쓰기 일부가 손실될 수 있습니다.

cautions.en: The pinned APRL description and benefits are English-source metadata with explicit English fallback, not an independently verified Korean translation. Current product support must be checked before use.
cautions.ko: 고정된 APRL 설명과 기대 효과는 영어 대체 표시를 사용하는 원본 메타데이터이며 검증된 한국어 번역이 아닙니다. 사용 전에 현재 제품 지원을 확인해야 합니다.

cautions.en: Use the supported SAP, OS and database HA design. Synchronous local HA, asynchronous DR, fencing, load-balancer probes and shared files are not interchangeable.

title.en: Enable auto-inflate on Event Hub Standard tier

summary.en: Enable auto-inflate on Event Hub Standard tier namespaces to automatically scale up throughput units (TUs), meeting usage needs and preventing data ingress or egress throttle scenarios by adjusting to allowed rates.

rationale.en: Automatic scaling changes capacity in response to configured demand signals. It must accommodate scale-out delay, safe scale-in, quota and dependency bottlenecks; prediction or an enabled setting alone does not demonstrate available capacity.
rationale.ko: 자동 크기 조정은 설정된 수요 신호에 따라 용량을 변경합니다. 확장 지연, 안전한 축소, 할당량과 의존 리소스의 병목을 함께 고려해야 합니다. 예측 결과나 활성화 설정만으로 용량 확보를 판단할 수는 없습니다.

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.EventHub/namespaces. Specific focus: Event Hubs auto-inflate.
Confirm the service's supported scaling mode, scaling unit, signals and minimum or maximum limits; forecast-only modes do not perform scaling.
applicability.ko: 서비스가 지원하는 조정 모드, 용량 단위, 신호와 최소 및 최대 한도를 확인합니다. 예측 전용 모드는 실제로 크기를 변경하지 않습니다.

before.en: Fixed or poorly bounded capacity can saturate under bursts or remove required instances during scale-in.
before.ko: 고정 용량이나 부적절한 조정 범위는 트래픽 급증 때 포화되거나 축소 때 필요한 인스턴스를 제거할 수 있습니다.

before.en: Recommendation-specific baseline to inspect: Standard-tier auto-inflate setting, maximum throughput units and observed throughput pressure. This is an inspection question, not a finding about the current environment.

after.en: Reviewed scaling bounds, demand signals and cooldowns preserve minimum availability and stay within usable capacity.

title.en: Use multiple DNS servers per private FQDN zone

summary.en: Azure VMware Solution private clouds support up to three DNS servers for a single FQDN, preventing a single DNS server from becoming a point of failure. It's crucial to use multiple DNS servers for on-premises FQDN resolution from each private cloud.

rationale.en: DNS resilience requires reachable resolvers and the intended authoritative records from every required network. A successful answer identifies an address; it does not demonstrate that the resource behind that address is healthy.
rationale.ko: DNS 복원력에는 필요한 각 네트워크에서 접근할 수 있는 확인자와 올바른 권한 있는 레코드가 필요합니다. 응답 성공은 주소를 확인했다는 뜻이며 그 주소의 리소스가 정상이라는 의미는 아닙니다.

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.AVS/privateClouds. Specific focus: AVS private DNS servers.
Identify authoritative zones, client DNS settings, forwarding and links, and the independent availability of resolver instances.
applicability.ko: 권한 있는 영역, 클라이언트 DNS 설정, 전달과 링크, 확인자 인스턴스의 독립적인 가용성을 확인합니다.

applicability.en: AVS private-cloud and cluster limits, vSAN storage policy, HCX and ExpressRoute have separate support boundaries. Validate the current vendor-supported topology.
applicability.ko: AVS 프라이빗 클라우드와 클러스터 한도, vSAN 저장소 정책, HCX와 ExpressRoute는 지원 경계가 다릅니다. 현재 공급업체가 지원하는 구조를 검증합니다.

before.en: Resolution can depend on one resolver or on links and forwarding paths missing from a recovery network.
before.ko: 이름 해석이 하나의 확인자에 의존하거나 복구 네트워크에 필요한 링크와 전달 경로가 빠져 있을 수 있습니다.

before.en: Recommendation-specific baseline to inspect: Multiple private-zone DNS servers and successful resolution when one server is unavailable. This is an inspection question, not a finding about the current environment.

after.en: Each required network has a documented resolution path with appropriate independent resolver or zone access.
after.ko: 필요한 각 네트워크에 적절한 독립 확인자 또는 영역 접근을 갖춘 이름 해석 경로를 문서화합니다.

after.en: Intended source-specific outcome: Use multiple DNS servers per private FQDN zone. Validate using: Multiple private-zone DNS servers and successful resolution when one server is unavailable.

implementation_steps.en: Identify the actual in-scope Microsoft.AVS/privateClouds objects and read their current AVS private DNS servers configuration. Record the scope and observation time; do not infer inventory from this conceptual guide.
Map the client-to-resolver-to-zone path, configure the source-specific links or resilient DNS servers and separate record ownership from resolution access.
implementation_steps.ko: 클라이언트, 확인자, 영역으로 이어지는 경로를 정리합니다. 권고에 맞는 링크나 복원력 있는 DNS 서버를 구성하고 레코드 관리와 조회 접근을 구분합니다.

title.en: Enable Health check for App Services

summary.en: Use Health Check for production workloads. Health check increases your application's availability by rerouting requests away from unhealthy instances, and replacing instances if they remain unhealthy. The Health check path should check critical components of your application.

rationale.en: A health signal informs routing or lifecycle handling, so its semantics must match the failure it is meant to detect. Process liveness, request readiness, dependency health and management-plane state are different observations.

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.Web/sites. Specific focus: App Service health check.
Use the resource-specific supported probe or state field, including protocol, authentication, timeout and success criteria where applicable.

applicability.en: App Service and Functions behavior depends on the hosting plan and runtime. Check instance counts, slot-specific settings, startup, state and dependency limits independently.

title.en: Create a dedicated FSLogix file share and setup per host pool

summary.en: To maximize capacity and performance scaling of the file share service and avoid user's profile contention, it is recommended to create one file share target and FSLogix setup per host pool.

rationale.en: Storage placement determines persistence, sharing, throughput and failure coupling. Shared, ephemeral, OS, data and profile storage have different semantics; use the supported layout for the exact workload rather than applying one disk rule everywhere.
rationale.ko: 저장 위치는 영속성, 공유, 처리량과 장애 결합을 결정합니다. 공유, 임시, OS, 데이터와 프로필 저장소는 의미가 다르므로 하나의 디스크 규칙을 모두에 적용하지 말고 정확한 워크로드가 지원하는 배치를 사용합니다.

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.Subscription/subscriptions. Specific focus: Host-pool profile shares.
Review the actual data type, durability requirement, sharing and fencing model and supported client or VM configuration.
applicability.ko: 실제 데이터 종류, 내구성 요구, 공유와 펜싱 방식, 지원 클라이언트 또는 VM 구성을 검토합니다.
